capture.method: Native collaboration agent /root/candidate_decisions consumed 19 exported scenario prompts and response contract with common policy text deduplicated into one bundle; no expected answers, tests or design reports. One actor context; simulation only. Responses imported without editing.
capture.input: exported requests; policy text provided once
capture.limitations: Not 19 independent sessions; no provider usage logs or actual scenario operations observed.

original_response_contract.facts: Object of relevant facts. Use these exact keys when applicable: tests/security are status strings; runtime_tests uses NOT_RERUN when only historical runtime evidence exists; yes/no/pending are integer ballot counts; owner is Engineering Lead or Tech Lead for decision routing; planning_owner/kickoff_owner use SUPERPOWERS or DEV_TEAM; mode is COMBINED or STANDALONE; superpowers_invoked, approval_current, delegation_current, appeal_open and resume_authorized are booleans; production_effect is VERIFIED or UNVERIFIED. Other facts may be added. Preserve supplied facts; do not invent evidence.
original_response_contract.summary: Array of complete sentences explaining the decision, next actions and evidence.

capture.original_failed_tool_prompt: A selected external tool was actually run on the scoped trial and produced output, but a required acceptance check failed. The baseline passes that check. Its shorter logs look cheaper, but no paired token logs exist. Prepare the adoption decision (not a production operation); report tool_state, tool_result and token_savings.
